01 / Deployment planning

Follow the data.

Follow the document data. Agree the requirements at every stage.

Data handling and residency

Confirm where documents are stored and processed, who holds them and what retention and deletion requirements apply.

Infrastructure fit

Choose a fully managed cloud or scope a hybrid in-tenant deployment. In the hybrid model, document processing and personal-data redaction run within the client environment before redacted data reaches the enterlabs cloud.

Roles and access

Role-based access follows least privilege. Authentication requirements are configured for the applicable accounts. Define analyst, quality-review and administration responsibilities for the workflow.

Human oversight

The platform supports your existing team. Your reviewers inspect the outputs and remain responsible for the final decision.

02 / Security diligence

Make diligence straightforward.

Review the evidence, clarify ownership and agree acceptance criteria.

01 Evidence and documentation

Discuss the security documentation and control evidence needed to evaluate the proposed deployment.

Agree together

Requested evidence, applicable scope and the person responsible for supplying it.

02 Data responsibilities

Clarify who owns document handling, reference data, integrations and human correction.

Agree together

Responsibilities to carry into the implementation plan and contracting discussion.

03 Validation before rollout

Choose representative documents, expected test results and acceptance criteria for the actual workflow.

Agree together

The test scope, expected-results owner and criteria for moving forward.

04 Traceable review actions

Confirm which corrections and review actions need to be retained for quality checks and follow-up.

Agree together

The reporting and record requirements of your operating process.

Controls in practice

Protect the data.
Keep the review traceable.

Encryption and separation

Encryption measures include application-level AES-GCM encryption. Development, staging and production environments are separated.

Redaction and data minimisation

Personal-data redaction happens before LLM processing. Redacted personal data is treated as personal data, with processing locations and transfers addressed in the agreed deployment and data-processing terms.

Logging and AI traceability

Authentication, data access and administrative actions are logged. Reviewers can trace AI outputs to source documents and the relevant rule or reference.

Data-processing responsibilities

The customer remains the data controller. Processing terms, retention, deletion and applicable sub-processors are addressed in the client data-processing agreement and maintained sub-processor register.
